page.overview:
What is Africa?

Africa is a real-world continent found on Earth. Its first appearance in Mario-related media is the Saturday Supercade episode "Hairy Parent," but the first appearance of Africa in a Mario game is Mario is Missing!.

Egypt is the most famous country within Africa and the most recurring within Mario-related media.

, Luigi visits a few cities in Africa on his journey to rescue Mario, including: In all versions of Mario's Time Machine, Egypt is featured as one of the locations that Mario travels to.

While not appearing in gameplay, Africa, along with Earth's other continents, is featured on the online racing menus in the entries of the Mario Kart series that support online play, including Mario Kart DS, Mario Kart Wii, Mario Kart 7, and Mario Kart 8 along with its remake Mario Kart 8 Deluxe.
